items.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
items.description: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

items.title: Rice is a rounded midfielder, but could be more selfish - Murphy
items.description: BBC Sport's Kelly Cates and Micah Richards discuss how rounded Declan Rice has become in Arsenal's midfield, while Danny Murphy argues that if he was more selfish he would score more goals.

items.title: 'He's been fantastic' - how Konsa has fitted in seamlessly at Arsenal
items.description: BBC Sport's Kelly Cates, Danny Murphy and Micah Richards analyse how good Ezri Konsa has been for Arsenal after signing from Aston Villa in the summer, especially in their 1-0 Premier League win against Liverpool at Anfield.

items.title: Were Arsenal 'lucky' not to concede penalty at Liverpool?
items.description: BBC Sport's Kelly Cates, Danny Murphy and Micah Richards discuss Liverpool's denied penalty claim for a pull on Alexander Isak's shirt by Arsenal defender Jurrien Timber and whether the Reds can feel hard done by.

items.title: Man Utd eye Barcelona's Balde - Monday's gossip
items.description: Alejandro Balde could leave Barcelona, sparking interest from Manchester United, Liverpool shortlist want Murillo and Nico Schlotterbeck, Real Madrid eye Bart Verbruggen, plus more.

items.title: Defensive 'masterclass' and elite Rice - how Arsenal ended Anfield torment
items.description: Not since 2012 - when current boss Mikel Arteta was commanding Arsenal's midfield on the pitch - had the Gunners won on Liverpool’s patch. That curse has finally been broken.

items.title: Rice relishing title race 'anxiety' after win at Liverpool
items.description: Declan Rice joins BBC Sport's Kelly Cates, Danny Murphy and Micah Richards to analyse how Arsenal earned their first Premier League victory at Liverpool in 14 years.

items.title: I'll tell my players to dive in future - Iraola
items.description: Andoni Iraola says that he will tell his players to go down in future after Liverpool were denied a penalty in Sunday's defeat by Arsenal.

items.title: Warnock hid seizures from Liverpool as a youngster
items.description: Former Premier League footballer Stephen Warnock says he hid seizures from Liverpool as a youngster because he feared he would be released.

items.title: From Fleetwood embarrassment to 'magical' Anfield win 14 years in making
items.description: Arsenal bounce back from the low of defeat at League Two Fleetwood to secure their first win in 14 years at Anfield - and open up a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League.

items.title: Boy, 14, hands himself in to police over Bradley Lowery video
items.description: A 14-year-old has handed himself into West Midlands Police after Coventry City said they were investigating a video appearing to show a fan taunting Sunderland supporters with a picture of Bradley Lowery.

items.title: Isak's non-penalty and Madueke-Mac Allister 'headbutt' - were big calls right?
items.description: There were two big flashpoints during Arsenal's 1-0 win over Liverpool, demonstrating the good and bad sides of VAR.
